sources.title: FinBERT: Financial Sentiment Analysis with BERT - GitHub
sources.snippet: FinBERT is a pre-trained NLP model to analyze sentiment of financial text. It is built by further training the BERT language model in the finance domain, using a large financial corpus and thereby fine-tuning it for financial sentiment classification. For the details, please see FinBERT: Financial Sentiment Analysis with Pre-trained Language ...

sources.title: finbert: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview FinBERT is a financial sentiment analysis model built by further training the BERT language model on financial domain text, then fine-tuning it on the Financial PhraseBank dataset. Maintained by ProsusAI, it classifies financial text into three sentiment labels: positive, negative, or neutral via softmax outputs.
